Hymn 280: Welcome, Welcome, Sabbath Morning
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: B-flat Major
Composer: Ebenezer Beesley
Lyricist/Text Author: Robert B. Baird
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 280 titled "Welcome, Welcome, Sabbath Morning" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in B-flat Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Ebenezer Beesley and the lyrics were written by Robert B. Baird.
This hymn is categorized under: Special Topics.
